sources.title: N.C.G.S. § 131E-117, Declaration of patient's rights
sources.notes: The General Assembly's single-section PDF, captured whole — no slice, because the document is the section. Plain curl with a pinned browser user-agent is enough for ncleg.gov. The Assembly prints its own hyphenation character inside section numbers and defined terms; that character is the document's and is carried through rather than folded to an ASCII hyphen.

sources.title: NC Medicaid, Nursing Home Notice of Transfer/Discharge, NC Medicaid-9050 (PDF)
sources.notes: The department's own notice form, captured whole. The blank rules, the checkbox glyphs and the form-number line are the form's own and are what the page quotes; -layout keeps the field labels beside the rules rather than reflowing them into a single column. Note the URL's own spelling, 'dicharge' — it is the department's path, not a typo to correct, and a corrected URL 404s.

sources.title: NC Medicaid, Appeals and Grievances — NC Medicaid Hearing Office
sources.notes: Server-rendered; plain curl with a browser user-agent returns the whole document. Scope 'body' because the page renders its 'Skilled Nursing Facility Discharge Appeals' block twice — once collapsed in an accordion and once expanded — and the standing packet holds both as served. A narrower scope would silently drop one pass of the block the page quotes from.

sources.title: NCDHHS Division of Aging, Long-Term Care Ombudsman
sources.notes: Server-rendered, same transport. This page publishes no statewide telephone number for the ombudsman program — it describes a state office and sixteen regional offices housed in Area Agencies on Aging — and that absence is recorded on the page as a finding. Scope stays 'body' so a future pass cannot mistake a narrowed capture for the contact having been withdrawn.
